conclusion.conditions_are_not_a_lookup_table: all 8 validation tasks sit at condition combinations unseen in training; 0.40 rel-RMSE on them is interpolation of a continuous condition -> scale map, not memorised task ids
conclusion.conditions_are_used: shifting the condition block to another task costs +0.0375 rel-RMSE (0.3998 -> 0.4373, COND_SUPERVISED), zeroing it costs +0.0745; the network does read the condition block
conclusion.identity_only_predictor_is_far_worse: a design-blind condition -> train-task-mean predictor scores 0.933 rel-RMSE, so the conditional model is not reproducing per-task offsets only; most of the signal is the design-shape response shared across tasks
conclusion.maml_with_conditioning_has_little_room: with the condition block present the fine-tuning gain is 0.025-0.029 rel-RMSE; the M3 question is whether online adaptation still pays when the task physics is given up front, and S3/S4 must answer it with actual optimisation curves

condition_coverage.note: Validation Machs (1.7/1.9/2.1/2.3) and lift fractions (0.90/1.08) never occur in training (Machs 1.65-2.35 step 0.10, fractions 0.86/1.00/1.14); every validation task is a midpoint interpolation in both condition dimensions with zero exact grid overlap, so a lookup table cannot produce the M1 result.

protocol.note: no evaluator budget spent; reuses S1 labels and M1 checkpoints
